gen.crop_origin: top-left (0,0) of the image AFTER the condition is applied; clean = native pixel grid, no resize
gen.condition_code: experiments/lib/perturb.py apply_condition(img, cond, key=sha256, seed=0), applied to the FULL decoded RGB image, identical for all classes, BEFORE the crop
gen.gray: PIL convert('L') of the RGB crop
gen.residual: x - Wiener3x3(x) (scipy.signal.wiener formula, mode=reflect borders), then row and column zero-mean
fingerprint_sources: clean (train images of the clean condition; realistic)
matched (train images under the test condition)
gen.spectral: mean |FFT2(residual)| per generator, centred by the all-train mean spectrum; same NCC; reported, not judged

dev.fingerprint: PRNU MLE K = sum(r*x)/(sum(x^2)+eps), x = gray, r = zero-meaned Wiener residual, eps = 1.0, leave-one-photo-out
dev.score: PCE at zero shift (signed), peak-excluded 11x11 window; best of orientation variants {0,180}

label_rule: PASS-i: clean bacc >= 0.60 (point). KILL-i: clean bacc < 0.30. PASS-ii: native 14-way top-1 >= 0.70 AND within-model >= 0.70. KILL-ii: native 14-way < 0.30. H-A2 PASS if PASS-i or PASS-ii; KILL if KILL-i and KILL-ii; else INCONCLUSIVE. Validity gates of docs/08 s3 -> INVALID if violated. M1 margin (CI lower bound of bacc minus M1 >= 0.10) reported as annotation.
